# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 1109 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [skills.sh](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/skills-sh.html) (added 2026-10-18): Vercel Labs' open-source CLI (npx skills) and directory for finding, installing and sharing agent skills across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and 75+ other coding agents.
- [CLI-Anything](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/cli-anything.html) (added 2026-10-18): Open-source project from HKUDS that generates agent-native command-line interfaces for existing software, codebases and web APIs, with CLI-Hub, a registry of community CLIs that coding agents can install and drive.
- [Pi](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/pi.html) (added 2026-10-18): Minimal, extensible open-source terminal coding agent and agent toolkit from Earendil, with a multi-provider LLM API, TypeScript SDK, RPC mode and installable extensions, skills and themes.
- [OneSignal MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/onesignal-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): OneSignal's official hosted MCP server for managing users, segments, templates, push and email messages and analytics from AI clients.
- [OpenZeppelin MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/openzeppelin-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): OpenZeppelin's official MCP servers that let agents generate secure smart contracts from audited OpenZeppelin libraries for Solidity, Cairo, Stellar and more.
- [Pimlico AI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/pimlico-ai.html) (added 2026-10-18): CLI and MCP server that lets coding agents manage a Pimlico smart-account infrastructure account, from balances and logs to sponsorship policies.
- [Pyth Pro MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/pyth-pro-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): Pyth's hosted MCP server that gives agents real-time and tick-level price history for crypto, FX, equities, metals and rates.
- [Mirror CLI](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mirror-cli.html) (added 2026-10-18): Reflection AI's terminal coding agent that reads code, edits files and runs commands in isolated git worktrees, using the open-weight Beam model by default.
- [Eney](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/eney.html) (added 2026-10-18): MacPaw's proactive AI assistant for Mac and iPhone that finds files, drafts replies and completes tasks across your connected apps.
- [Leap](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/leap.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI developer agent that builds full-stack apps and deploys them to your own AWS or GCP account, so you keep the code.
- [Fellou](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/fellou.html) (added 2026-10-18): Agentic browser that carries out multi-step tasks across websites, runs deep searches and turns results into reports.
- [Rork](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/rork.html) (added 2026-10-18): AI builder for native iOS, Android and web apps that takes you from a prompt to App Store and Google Play publishing.
